claim: On Night 2 Circus Baby tells the player she does not recognize him and that he is new, but that she remembers 'this scenario'. She wonders what would lead a person to spend their nights there willingly.
quote: I don't recognize you. You are new. I remember this... scenario, however. It's a strange thing to want to do, to come here.
location: Night 2, Circus Baby (Circus Control, power outage)

when.label: Sister Location, Night 2 (undated)

notes: She goes on: 'I'm curious what events would lead a person to want to spend their nights in a place like this... willingly. Maybe curiosity? Maybe ignorance.' Compare the last cutscene's 'They didn't recognize me at first, but then... they thought I was you'. If its speaker is the player, this line is the first half of that sentence, said from the other side.

title: Bidybabs: 'Is it the same person?'
claim: While the player hides under the Circus Control desk on Night 2, the small animatronics outside say that someone is inside and ask whether it is the same person.
quote: Is it the same person?

when.label: Sister Location, Night 2 (undated)
when.basis: SL gives no calendar date; HandUnit places it after 'the unfortunate closing of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza'.

notes: Their other lines: 'Hello in there.', 'Someone is inside.', 'Knock knock.', 'We always find a way inside.', 'She's watching us!' 'The same person' is whoever used the hiding place before; the game does not say who that was or what became of him, though HandUnit mentions a dead body once found in a vent.

title: Baby: 'I was on stage once... only one day'
claim: On Night 3 Circus Baby says she was on stage only once, for a single day, in a small room with balloons and tables where no one sat while children ran in and out, and that she always counted the children in the room with her.
quote: Did you know that I was on stage once? It wasn't for very long, only one day. What a wonderful day though.

when.label: Before Sister Location (undated past)
when.basis: Described as past events by Circus Baby / shown as memories; no date given.

notes: Her counts: 'Two, then three, then two, then three, then four, then two, then none.' and later 'There were four, then three, then two... then one. Something happened when there was one.' She adds 'I can make ice cream! Although I only did it once.' One day on stage before a few children at a time fits Scott's hidden news report, in which the Pizza World's opening was cancelled and only 'a handful' of children ever saw the inside. The girl's own last line asks 'Where did the other children go?'

title: Technicians: 'these things can't go a day without breaking down'
claim: On Night 4 two technicians bring Ballora into the scooping room while the player watches from inside the suit. One complains that 'these things' cannot go a day without breaking down; the other says it is always some hardware malfunction and that the process is automated, so they can leave.
quote: What happened to it this time? It just seems like these things can't go a day without breaking down.
location: Night 4, Scooping Room (heard from inside the springlock suit)

when.label: Sister Location, Night 4 (undated)
when.basis: SL gives no calendar date; HandUnit places it after 'the unfortunate closing of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza'.

notes: The reply: 'Who knows. It's always the same, man. Some kinda hardware malfunction.' and 'It's all automated, we don't have to be here for it. Just get her on the rollers and, we can go.' The two men speak of breakdowns and of an automated process they need not stay for. Two figures hang in the galleries the next night (sl-technicians-hanged).

title: Scooping room: all four 'have already been here today'
claim: In the scooping room the voice tells the player that Funtime Foxy, Funtime Freddy, Ballora and Circus Baby have each 'already been here today'.
quote: Funtime Foxy has already been here today. Funtime Freddy has already been here today. Ballora has already been here today. Circus Baby has already been here today.

when.label: Sister Location, Night 5 (undated)
when.basis: SL gives no calendar date; HandUnit places it after 'the unfortunate closing of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza'.

notes: It opens: 'You are in the scooping room now.' The voice is Circus Baby's, and it names Circus Baby in the third person among those that have 'already been here today'. The usual reading is that the speaker is what was taken out of the four. Scott's teaser for the combined figure reads 'There's a little of me in every body.'

title: 'I've been out before, but they always put me back'
claim: The voice says it has been out before but 'they' always put it back, that they always put 'us' back inside, and that there is nowhere for them to hide in the facility.
quote: I've been out before, but they always put me back. They always put us back inside. There is nowhere for us to hide here.

when.label: Sister Location, Night 5 (undated)
when.basis: SL gives no calendar date; HandUnit places it after 'the unfortunate closing of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza'.

notes: 'They' are not named; the game shows the technicians and the scooper's routine. The line slides from 'me' to 'us'. Reading: this is why the voice wants to look like the player; in the same scene it says 'if we looked like you, then we could hide' (sl-real-ending-if-we-looked-like-you).

title: Outside the Private Room: 'We need you, so that we can leave'
claim: Outside the Private Room, before 4 AM, the voice says they do not want to hurt anyone but need the player so that they can leave, hide and look like him, and tells him he will not die.
quote: We don't want to hurt anyone, but we need you. We need you, so that we can leave. We need you, so that we can hide.
location: Night 5 Fake Ending (Private Room), before 4 AM

when.label: Sister Location, Night 5 (undated)
when.basis: SL gives no calendar date; HandUnit places it after 'the unfortunate closing of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza'.

notes: In Circus Baby's voice. Further lines: 'We need you... so that we can look like you.', 'If they find us like this, we won't be able to try again.', 'You must let us inside the room.', 'You won't die. And it will only hurt for a moment.' and, last, 'I will find a way out.' The same words are repeated over the fallen purple man in the last walking cutscene (sl-you-wont-die).

title: The soap opera at home: a vampire who says the baby isn't his
claim: After Nights 1, 2 and 4 the player is at home watching 'The Immortal and the Restless', a soap opera in which a vampire, Vlad, keeps telling Clara that her baby is not his while she lists the vampire things the child does and tells him to be part of his son's life. She sets his house on fire. The finale, shown only after the Private Room night, ends with the two kissing and the narrator asking what will become of the baby.
location: Between-night home scenes (after Nights 1, 2 and 4; finale after the Fake Ending)

when.label: During Sister Location (undated)
when.basis: SL gives no calendar date.

notes: Paraphrased: the wiki's transcripts differ in small words, so no line is quoted. Vlad's excuses include that he is an old man who cannot be a father; Clara says he works the graveyard shift at a fast-food place. No episode follows Night 3, when the player does not get home. A father refusing to own his child, shown each night to a man who turns out to be on an errand for his own father, reads as a deliberate parallel. That is interpretation: the show never refers to the game's characters.

title: A clock at the end of the Left Hall; a grandfather clock in the minigame hallway
claim: In the night gameplay a clock with a round pale face in a reddish-brown wooden case is at the dark far end of the Left Hall, and framed pictures hang on the hall's walls. The minigame house's hallway has a grandfather clock with a pendulum and five framed blue pictures on its wall.
location: Night gameplay, Left Hall (far end, in the dark); minigame house, hallway (post-Night 1 and post-Night 3 minigames)

when.label: During FNaF4's nights (undated)
when.basis: FNaF4's night gameplay gives no date.

verifiedVia: https://freddy-fazbears-pizza.fandom.com/wiki/File:LeftHall.png (the game's render, brightened) ; https://freddy-fazbears-pizza.fandom.com/wiki/Left_Hall ; 720p captures, hallway at c. 154 s of https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=36TkKbnWEQA and in https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pTCY2dDFdp0
notes: Upper left: the game's Left Hall render, brightened; the white outline marks the area enlarged at right. Lower left: the minigame hallway, the Fredbear plush sitting on its clock. At the game's own brightness the far end of the hall is almost black and the clock is easy to miss. Even brightened, its hands can barely be made out and its lower part is lost in the dark, so the still does not show whether it stands on the floor like the minigame's clock or hangs on the wall; the wiki calls it a grandfather clock. A paler cap above the dial appears to be the top of the case, and nothing recognisable as a figure is on it. The wiki also mentions a box beside the clock; the still shows a low object there that cannot be identified. In the lit part of the 3D hall a large framed picture and a group of small ones hang on the walls; the 8-bit pictures are plain blue rectangles in dark-red frames. The two clocks are a 3D model and an 8-bit sprite and cannot be matched in detail. A clock in a picture-hung hallway is the one fixture the gameplay house and the minigame house visibly share; the game never states that they are one house. The wiki says the clock chimes during play (audio, not checked).

title: The lake ending: the player's sprite goes into Old Man Consequences' lake
claim: At Old Man Consequences' lake the player's sprite can go into the water. The screen then turns black with one white shape at its centre, and afterwards shows a black human silhouette in front of a white rectangle, its arms held out and down to either side, with a grey shape at each side. No text appears.

The ending has no trophy of its own. The game does not say who the three shapes on the last screen are. UCN returns to this lake and leaves its player nothing to do but sink into it (ucn-omc-ending-drowning).

title: Chipper's Revenge: 'You wanted to be scared... Obscurity...'
claim: Beaten, the optional boss Chipper's Revenge says that it was always supposed to be him, that his lush, colourful world was not enough for the player, who wanted to be scared, and that what happened to him was obscurity. He vows that he, not Freddy Fazbear, will sharpen his teeth on the player's bones. 'The End' follows.
quote: You haven't seen the last of me. Freddy Fazbear isn't the one who will be sharpening his teeth on your bones. It will be me.
